verdict.reason: The todo file's checklist item at docs/tasks/active/20260917-self-review-loop-todo.md:70 asserts `.claude/commands/self-review.md` was delivered ("- [x] `.claude/commands/self-review.md` — drives the bounded loop..."), and the same claim is repeated in docs/design/agentic-dev-loop.md:57, CONTRIBUTING.md:185, and CLAUDE.md:65-66 as the mechanism that drives `/self-review`. I independently confirmed via Glob that a `.claude` directory does not exist anywhere in the working tree (`Glob .claude/**` → "Directory does not exist: .claude"), `Glob **/self-review.md` → no results, and a case-insensitive Grep for `selfreview`/`self_review` variants found no command-definition file (only agent scripts and archived, unrelated task docs). I also checked for alternate slash-command formats (e.g. `.toml`) and found none related. This is a documentation-vs-repository-state contradiction squarely in the Docs lens's 'documentation contradicted by this PR's own code' lane: the task file marks the command's creation as done and multiple other docs describe it as the thing that 'drives' `/self-review`, yet no such file exists on disk anywhere in the repo. I found no counterexample after a wide, multi-angle search, so I cannot refute this absence claim.
